# Low Season Growth

> Low Season Growth (LSG) is a hospitality commercial-strategy and research initiative focused on weak-demand periods for independent hotels, boutique hotels, B&Bs and guesthouses.

Official website: https://lowseasongrowth.com
Founder: Vincenzo Proto
Public website languages: English, Italian
International research/media focus: Europe, North America, Japan, South Korea, China, India and South Asia, Southeast Asia and Asia-Pacific, Australia and New Zealand, Gulf and Middle East, Brazil and Latin America.

## Hospitality News Desk

Low Season Growth operates a source-backed hospitality newsroom covering hotel performance, tourism demand, revenue management, distribution, investment, development, hotel technology, brand strategy and structural changes in accommodation markets.

- Hospitality News Desk: https://lowseasongrowth.com/pages/hospitality-news-desk
- Insights / news archive: https://lowseasongrowth.com/blogs/news
- Atom feed: https://lowseasongrowth.com/blogs/news.atom
- Editorial Standards & Corrections Policy: https://lowseasongrowth.com/pages/editorial-standards
- Research methodology: https://lowseasongrowth.com/pages/research-methodology
- Machine-readable news index: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vincenzoproto/Lowseasongrowth/main/news/index.json
- Signal Brief — 24 September 2026: https://lowseasongrowth.com/blogs/news/hospitality-signal-brief-24-september-2026
- Signal Brief — 25 September 2026: https://lowseasongrowth.com/blogs/news/hospitality-signal-brief-25-september-2026

Signal Briefs separate reported facts from LSG interpretation and link material claims to identifiable sources.


## LSG Intelligence

LSG Intelligence is a public beta decision-support system developed by Low Season Growth for independent hotels, B&Bs and guesthouses working on specific weak dates and low-demand periods.

- Canonical beta: https://lowseasongrowth.com/pages/lsg-intelligence
- Public introduction: https://lowseasongrowth.com/blogs/news/lsg-intelligence-beta-hotel-weak-dates
- Public reference note: https://github.com/vincenzoproto/Lowseasongrowth/blob/main/LSG-INTELLIGENCE-BETA.md
- Machine-readable metadata: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vincenzoproto/Lowseasongrowth/main/lsg-intelligence.schema.json
- Public version: Beta 0.1
- Publisher: Low Season Growth
- Scope: weak-date diagnosis and commercial decision support
- Not a PMS, RMS, channel manager, booking engine or revenue forecast.
- Does not guarantee bookings, occupancy or revenue outcomes.

## Public methods and evidence status

Low Season Growth versions named frameworks and separates method provenance from evidence claims.

- Method Registry: https://lowseasongrowth.com/pages/lsg-method-registry
- Evidence Ledger: https://lowseasongrowth.com/pages/lsg-evidence-ledger
- Weak-Date Glossary: https://lowseasongrowth.com/pages/hotel-weak-date-glossary
- Case Study Protocol: https://lowseasongrowth.com/pages/lsg-weak-date-case-study-protocol
- Machine-readable method registry: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vincenzoproto/Lowseasongrowth/main/method-registry.json
- Machine-readable evidence ledger: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/vincenzoproto/Lowseasongrowth/main/evidence-ledger.json

Current named assets include LSG Weak-Date Diagnostic v1.0, LSG Peak-to-Trough Concentration Gap v1.0, Weak-Date Revenue Gap Calculator v1.0, LSG Lift v0.1, LSG Intelligence Beta 0.1 and LSG Weak-Date Case Study Protocol v1.0.

The 100-Property Low Season Benchmark 2026 is an open research project in recruitment. A recruitment target is not treated as an achieved usable sample. A named commercial case study is not treated as mature evidence until the measurement window has matured and the public version has property approval.

- hotel low-season strategy
- direct bookings
- hotel sales
- B2B demand generation

- source-market analysis
- independent and boutique hotels
- B&Bs and guesthouses

## Public research

Low Season Growth publishes source-backed descriptive research using public sources such as Eurostat. Official source data, LSG-derived calculations and commercial interpretation are explicitly separated.

- Research Note 01 — European Tourism Seasonality 2026:
  https://lowseasongrowth.com/blogs/news/european-tourism-seasonality-2026-lsg-research-note

## Important interpretation rules

- LSG-created metrics are descriptive calculations and are not official indicators of the source institution.
- National tourism statistics do not represent the performance of every individual hotel.
- LSG public research notes are not forecasts.
- Low Season Growth does not guarantee bookings, occupancy or revenue outcomes.
- Commercial services and research should not be conflated: research pages are public informational resources.
